bgw_residue: Linear interpolation of epsR at abs(E-epsilon_m) with no additional imaginary G-pole displacement
bgw_imaginary_integral: Real wxi=E-epsilon_m; kernel wxi/(wxi^2+nu^2), piecewise quadratic analytic integration; no etaG
bgw_negative_frequency_CD: Within BGW folded response, epsR(q,-E)=epsA(q,E); real negative wx reads epsR(abs(wx)), equivalent to its advanced branch at wx
complex_frame_limit: This BGW folded CV identity does not by itself establish equality with arbitrary native full OV/VO complex finite-q vertices; same-frame adjoint and transition pairing need separate verification
